svg.title: Battery evidence separates content claims from authority checks
svg.desc: The battery-passport design distinguishes content, evidence links and authority checks. A valid mandate and accredited issuer do not by themselves authenticate the exact reported carbon-footprint class. The diagram includes a content attack that can remain possible even when authority attestations are qualified. Source: paper [full paper], Figure 6.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Battery evidence separates content claims from authority checks

The battery-passport design distinguishes content, evidence links and authority checks. A valid mandate and accredited issuer do not by themselves authenticate the exact reported carbon-footprint class. The diagram includes a content attack that can remain possible even when authority attestations are qualified. Source: paper [full paper], Figure 6.
